Title: StorSimple Available In Japan East and West

Body.Content: StorSimple is now available in Japan East and Japan West with the same service-level agreement coverage available in other regions worldwide. StorSimple offers a unique hybrid cloud storage solution which provides large on-premises capacity for SSD and HDD, data protection, as well as data mobility through access to enterprise data in Microsoft Azure through the StorSimple Virtual Appliance. This solution optimizes total storage costs and data protection for enterprises, with consolidated management through Azure portal. For more information about services regional availability, please visit our Azure Regions page.
